title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard
workpass: 22 — optional local NLI integration, conservative compound-claim gating, and evidence-provenance persistence
method: Retains WorkPass 7 fixed weights; only research stream G and unique normalized task inventory changed where WorkPass22 adds canonical runtime NLI integration and tested fail-closed handling. Weighted implementation score is not release readiness or measured intelligence. NLI uses uncalibrated cross-encoder scores and all real-model inference/holdout conclusions remain open.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: No duplicate canonical owner; source manifests and metadata contract reconciled.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass16 makes browser smoke fail closed on required brand warnings and actual auth mismatch, exposes indeterminate auth state, validates bounded timeouts, and atomically publishes private verdict files. The 212/212 source-only UI script suite passes; dependency-complete UI build and actual browser E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass21 adds canonical syndicated-lineage dedup and mirror provenance to MemoryOS2, plus session restore reconstruction. Independent temporal holdout and measured retrieval uplift remain open.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass20 adds exact action execution/step receipt correlation and a persisted bounded idempotency ledger; duplicate/stale receipts cannot advance later project steps. Entire action→independent external receipt→reafference chain remains partial.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass22 integrates opt-in local DeBERTa cross-encoder NLI into canonical research assessment/Core gating, conservative atomization and restore validation. Mocked contract tests pass; real pretrained inference, score calibration, multilingual/adversarial holdout and broader source genealogy remain open.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Version/metadata and archive evidence improved; app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room drill and soak remain open.

normalizedTaskInventory.note: Normalized unique deliverables, not append-only historical tasklist line counts. PARTIAL is not always exactly half-complete; half-credit is a comparison aid.

openReleaseGates: Real autonomous research on at least two allowed external HTTPS hosts with distinct evidence and persisted source receipt
Real pretrained NLI inference on fixed labelled, multilingual/adversarial claim set; score calibration and threshold evaluation; atomic claim extraction remains conservative
Complete agency loop from competition to independent postcondition, persistence and reafference with cross-consumer no-double-credit
Entity correction/expiry/conflict across browser-backed multi-session flows
Portable subject continuity and behavioral fidelity
Capability evidence graph for critical user journeys
External provider delivery receipts, reconnect and replay guarantees
Clean-room backup/restore, schema migration and rollback drill
Research candidate integrations from NeuroCore/NOMEGA/DeepCode only where they measurably beat canonical baselines
Authorization/abuse/rate-limit review for diagnostic and benchmark APIs
Independent labelled temporal MemoryOS2 holdout and comparison to BM25 baseline
Dependency-complete app install and root/app semantic typecheck
Desktop/mobile browser E2E, including actual Live2D interaction
Multi-hour soak with memory and resource-growth limits
Final SBOM, license inventory and immutable release provenance sign-off
environmentNote: WorkPass22 passes runtime TypeScript, 20 claim evidence cases, 8 lineage cases, 20 semantic NLI cases against a mocked backend, 3 local NLI service contract cases with a mocked model stack, 5 project idempotency scenarios, and real OrganismCore integration against a loopback HTTP NLI fixture covering support/refute/outage/learning gates. Optional pretrained model inference, calibration and external labelled holdout were not run. UI build/browser E2E, live-provider validation, independent memory holdout and release durability remain open.
limitations: NLI integration is opt-in and calls a separately configured service. Scores are raw softmax outputs, not calibrated truth probabilities; tests here use a mocked backend and mocked model stack, not real weights.
Compound claim atomization is conservative and language-heuristic; it does not reliably parse arbitrary natural language or multi-hop claims.
Source lineage remains conservative near-duplicate/syndication detection, not complete upstream press-release genealogy.
A real independently labeled temporal MemoryOS2 holdout has not established retrieval uplift; experimental configs remain unpromoted.
Full agency chain from ActionCompetition through independent external receipt, reafference, persistence and UI remains partial despite receipt idempotency fixes.
Full app dependency installation, root/app semantic typecheck, React/Vite production build and desktop/mobile browser E2E remain open. The current environment lacks vite/vite-client app dependencies.
Clean-room install/restore/upgrade/rollback, multi-hour soak, provider reconnect stress and final SBOM/provenance sign-off remain open.
No release-ready status or human-like/biological intelligence claim is made.
